gaps.sentence: Did you remember ___ the window before we left?
gaps.explanation: 'Remember to do' = not forget an obligation; 'remember locking' recalls a past action.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.
can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.
bother + -ing (or to-infinitive): don't bother going. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.

gaps.sentence: My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)

gaps.sentence: It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.
